items.statement: The investigation reports an independent multi-start search, deduplication and stopping rationale for H2 and HMF on each named surface.
items.expected: Per-candidate identities and validation context are retained for both surfaces and coverage is justified without an author-route assumption.

items.statement: The selected HMF orientation endpoints and connecting paths are validated and numerical stability is tested.
items.expected: Both surfaces have endpoint connectivity, path validation and tighter-setting sensitivity evidence.

items.statement: The molecular H2 adsorption energy on Ni111 is measured.
The molecular H2 adsorption energy on NiPt111 is measured.
The Ni111 HMF parallel-to-tilted forward barrier is measured.
The NiPt111 HMF parallel-to-tilted forward barrier is measured.
Parallel HMF is lower in energy than tilted HMF on each surface.
items.expected: Both reported tilted-minus-parallel energies are positive.
